SELECT substr(filing_date, 6, 4) AS year, count(*) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.patex_application_data_25 WHERE length(filing_date) = 9 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 10
Which states have the highest average residential electricity rate by ZIP code?
SELECT state, avg(try_cast(res_rate AS double)) AS dollars_per_kwh FROM govblock_solar.urdb_zip_rates WHERE state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many awards in 2022 single audits were loans or loan guarantees?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_executive.fac_federal_awards WHERE audit_year = '2022' AND upper(substr(cast(is_loan AS varchar), 1, 1)) = 'Y'
Which neighbouring grids did New York trade the most power with in 2023?

SELECT directly_interconnected_balancing_authority, sum(abs(try_cast(interchange_mw AS double))) AS mwh_traded FROM govblock_solar.eia930_interchange WHERE balancing_authority = 'NYIS' AND data_date LIKE '%/2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many compounds in the lipophilicity set have a measured logD above 4?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.moleculenet_lipophilicity WHERE exp > 4
How are transmission line segments spread across voltage classes?
SELECT replace(volt_class, '"', ''), count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_electric_power_transmission_lines WHERE replace(volt_class, '"', '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many design patent applications has the USPTO received?
SELECT count(*) AS design_applications FROM govblock_patents.patex_application_data_25 WHERE invention_type = 'DES'
Which utilities sold the most electricity to industrial customers in 2020?

SELECT column02 AS utility, column06 AS state, try_cast(sales_2 AS double) AS industrial_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia861_sales_ult_cust_sheet_states WHERE column00 = '2020' AND column03 = 'A' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many historically Black colleges and universities does the College Scorecard list?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_education.scorecard_most_recent_institution WHERE cast(hbcu AS varchar) = '1'
How do EPA-regulated facilities stand on compliance?
SELECT fac_compliance_status, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_echo_exporter WHERE fac_compliance_status IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many unreviewed protein entries are linked to Rhea reactions?
SELECT count(DISTINCT id) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_rhea2uniprot_trembl
Which metro areas have the most banks headquartered in them?
SELECT cbsa_metro_name, count(*) AS banks FROM govblock_finance.fdic_institutions WHERE cast(active AS varchar) = '1' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much carbon dioxide did the United States emit from energy in 2020?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS million_metric_tons FROM govblock_energy.eia_emiss_data WHERE series_id = 'EMISS.CO2-TOTV-TT-TO-US.A' AND period = '2020'
Which companies sold the most electricity into the New York ISO in 2024?

SELECT seller_company_name, sum(try_cast(standardized_quantity AS double)) AS mwh FROM govblock_energy.ferceqr_transactions WHERE year_quarter LIKE '2024%' AND point_of_delivery_balancing_authority = 'NYIS' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many SAM.gov registrants are woman-owned businesses?
SELECT count(DISTINCT unique_entity_id) AS n FROM govblock_awards.sam_entity_business_types WHERE business_type_code = 'A2'
Which government forms run to the most pages?
SELECT form_number, title, try_cast(pages AS integer) AS pages FROM govblock_reference.forms ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many transfers between committees were reported in 2020?
SELECT count(*) AS transactions FROM govblock_fec.committee_transactions WHERE transaction_dt LIKE '%2020'
Which states had the most Medicare outpatient hospital services in 2023?
Medicare Outpatient Hospitals By Geography And Service

SELECT rndrng_prvdr_geo_desc AS state, sum(try_cast(capc_srvcs AS double)) AS services FROM govblock_health.medicare_outpatient_hospitals_by_geography_and_service WHERE rndrng_prvdr_geo_lvl = 'State' AND source_file LIKE '%DY23%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many lead and copper rule violations have begun since 2020?

SELECT count(DISTINCT violation_id) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_violations_enforcement WHERE contaminant_code = '5000' AND try_cast(substr(non_compl_per_begin_date, 7, 4) AS integer) >= 2020
Which companies run the most nuclear reactors?
SELECT parent_company_utility_name AS company, count(*) AS reactors FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_dataset_reactors_operating_query_1 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
When did Netflix file its first financial statements in the SEC data sets?
SELECT min(filed) AS first_filed FROM govblock_sec.sec_fsds_sub WHERE name LIKE 'NETFLIX%'
Which incorporated places in New York State are the most populous?
SELECT name, try_cast(popestimate2025 AS double) AS population FROM govblock_census.popest_sub_est WHERE cast(sumlev AS varchar) = '162' AND stname = 'New York' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many drug products in ChEMBL were approved in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_products WHERE substr(cast(approval_date AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2023'
Which states have the most incorporated places?
SELECT usps AS state, count(DISTINCT geoid) AS places FROM govblock_census.gazetteer_gaz_place WHERE funcstat = 'A' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many reviewed Swiss-Prot proteins are linked to Rhea reactions?
SELECT count(DISTINCT id) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_rhea2uniprot_sprot
Which industry codes have the most companies filing quarterly reports in 2024?
SELECT sic, count(DISTINCT cik) AS companies FROM govblock_sec.sec_fsds_sub WHERE form = '10-Q' AND cast(fy AS varchar) = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What did a kilowatt hour of electricity cost the average household in December 2024?
SELECT value AS dollars_per_kwh FROM govblock_labor.bls_ap_data WHERE series_id = 'APU000072610' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND period = 'M12'
Which states have the most sections of law in the library?
SELECT state, count(*) AS sections FROM govblock_law.law_combined GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of hospitals enrolled in Medicare are for-profit?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN proprietary_nonprofit = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_health.cms_hospital_enrollments
Which kinds of documents are posted most often on Regulations.gov?
SELECT replace(documenttype, '"', ''), count(*) AS n FROM govblock_regulations.regulations_gov_documents WHERE replace(documenttype, '"', '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of federal contract actions in fiscal 2024 were firm fixed price?

SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN type_of_contract_pricing = 'FIRM FIXED PRICE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2024'
Which kinds of debt does the Treasury Offset Program collect the most for?
SELECT mixed_stream, sum(try_cast(net_offset_amt AS double)) AS collected FROM govblock_treasury.treasury_offset_program WHERE mixed_stream IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
